my_servers_subtitle: Wake, stop, or claim the servers you can manage.
no_servers_hint: Claim an unowned server you have access to, or ask an admin to provision one.
my_servers_footer: Servers and game types are provisioned and managed by the platform. You claim a node to operate it; raw cluster config is never exposed here.
server_asleep_body: Wake it to boot a pod — the live console attaches automatically the moment it starts up.
server_shutting_down_body: The pod is terminating, so the live console has detached. It will be asleep in a moment.
server_failed_body: No pod is running, so there is nothing to stream. Wake it to retry; the console attaches once a pod comes back up.
console_offline_body: The live console attaches automatically as soon as the server is running.
log_ended_empty: Stream ended — reconnect to resume following the log.
players_link_desc: Manage the whitelist, online players, and bans.
luckperms_link_desc: Manage player groups and fine-grained permission nodes.
backups_link_desc: View and restore world backups for this server.
players_not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can manage this server's players.
players_not_running_body: Player management runs over a live connection to the server. Wake it to manage the whitelist, online players, and bans.
access_player_invalid: Player names are 1–16 letters, digits or underscores.
access_whitelist_desc: When the whitelist is on, only listed players can join.
access_whitelist_empty: No players on the whitelist yet.
access_whitelist_empty_hint: Add a player above to let them join.
access_online_desc: Players on the server right now.
access_online_empty: No one is online right now.
access_online_names_unavailable: {{count}} online, but the names couldn't be read.
access_online_names_unavailable_hint: See the raw server reply below for names.
access_ban_desc: Banning kicks a player and blocks them from rejoining. Expand to view the current ban list and pardon in one tap, or enter a full player ID to ban directly.
access_ban_confirm: Ban {{player}}? They'll be kicked and blocked from rejoining.
access_ban_empty_hint: Banned players show up here, ready to pardon in one tap.
create_server_desc: Pick from whitelisted images and sizes — the platform provisions the rest. No raw cluster config is exposed here.
create_server_subdomain_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
create_server_policy_owner: Owner only — wake from the panel
create_server_policy_public: Public — any player join wakes it
no_servers_managed: No servers under your management yet
no_servers_managed_hint: Use "New server" to provision one from the vetted spec.
server_admin_footer: Server creation goes through the structured form only — the platform maps your choices onto a vetted Kubernetes spec. Raw cluster config (host networking, host paths, arbitrary images, privileged pods) is never expressible here.
edit_server_desc: Configure display name, autostart policy, image, memory, and CPU
edit_server_desc_long: Updating server spec. Fields left unchanged will retain their current values.
luckperms_dialog_desc: Set or unset LuckPerms permission nodes and parent groups on the running server (requires the LuckPerms plugin to be active).
luckperms_error_invalid_player: Invalid player name (1–16 chars: letters, digits, underscore)
luckperms_error_invalid_node: Invalid permission node (allowed: letters, digits, ., -, _, *, 1-64 chars)
luckperms_error_invalid_group: Invalid group name (allowed: letters, digits, -, _, 1-48 chars)
luckperms_error_invalid_world: Invalid world context (allowed: letters, digits, -, _, 1-48 chars)
luckperms_desc: Manage player permission nodes and parent groups on this server (requires the LuckPerms plugin to be active).
luckperms_select_player_prompt: Please select an online player from the list, or enter a username to query.
luckperms_batch_players_placeholder: Enter player names, support multiple (separated by commas or spaces)
